ordinance_area_text: north or west of the trace of the line beginning at the intersection of North Landing Road and the Chesapeake-Virginia Beach city boundary line; thence northwardly along North Landing Road to Indian River Road; thence eastwardly along Indian River Road to New Bridge Road; thence northeastwardly along New Bridge Road to Sandbridge Road, thence eastwardly along Sandbridge Road to its intersection with the Atlantic Ocean, or across any land north of False Cape State Park and east of Shipps Bay and Point Creek.
method: constructed from official City of Virginia Beach street centerlines + TIGER 2023 water
notes: Main area: city outline split by the trace line (North Landing Rd from the North Landing River bridge north to Indian River Rd, Indian River Rd east to New Bridge Rd, New Bridge Rd NE to Sandbridge Rd, Sandbridge Rd east to the ocean), path traced along city centerlines; north/west side kept, including water (ordinance says 'land or water'). The trace line itself is high confidence. Second clause ('land north of False Cape State Park and east of Shipps Bay and Point Creek'): no feature named 'Point Creek' exists in GNIS/TIGER for Virginia Beach; interpreted as Hell Point Creek, the gut that separates the Sandbridge peninsula from the mainland marsh just south of Sandbridge Rd. Built as the barrier-beach land (water removed) east of Hell Point Creek, North Bay, Shipps Bay and Sand Bay, from Sandbridge Rd south to the north edge of False Cape State Park (~36.6305 N); includes Sandbridge Beach and the Back Bay NWR beach strip. Marsh islands west of Sand Bay (inside Back Bay) were NOT included - ambiguous whether they are 'east of Shipps Bay'. Back Bay NWR is federal land with its own hunting rules. Outline is the app's generalized city boundary, so edges along the Chesapeake line and the coast are approximate. Not shown: the separate (a)(1) Elbow Rd/Salem Rd/Landstown/Princess Anne line (only affects small-tract shotgun permits) and the (d) 150-yard rule, which applies citywide.
recovered: Recovered 2026-11 from public/data/local-areas.geojson (the original source files were lost); geometry carries that layer's 30% simplification.
